raw.query: SELECT variate, MIN(avg_wape) as best_wape FROM (SELECT variate, model, AVG(wape) as avg_wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics GROUP BY variate, model) sub GROUP BY variate ORDER BY best_wape
raw.claimed: Vision pool signals are both burstiest and most persistent
raw.evidence: Images have highest burstiness (cv2 up to 25.7) but worst forecastability (WAPE 0.89); requests are most persistent (WAPE 0.52)
raw.fix: Claim should state vision pool signals are burstiest but least persistent, or rephrase to 'burstiest and most volatile'
